$documentation: Dated, enumerated exemptions for the supply-chain bake-time gate
(scripts/check-dep-ages.mjs, run by the `Check dependency bake time` step in
An entry lets one otherwise checked version — an exact pin, or the version bun.lock resolves
a range to — stay on a release published less than FLAIR_DEP_MIN_AGE_DAYS ago.
The author supplies a GHSA-formatted id; review verifies the version fixes it.
Every entry carries a hard expiry. An
expired entry FAILS the gate before any registry request; removing it lets an
otherwise checked version be age-checked. Re-read the reason before re-dating; removing the entry
once the version has aged past the window is the normal outcome.

entries.reason: Root overrides pin body-parser 2.4.0, the first 2.x release that fixes GHSA-27r3-jxmh-p828 (HIGH, entered GitHub's database 2026-10-23). It was published 2026-10-22, inside the 7-day bake window, and the advisory blocks the Dependency Audit job. Its only consumer in the lockfile is express 5.2.1 (body-parser ^2.2.1), which the pin satisfies. 2.4.0 reaches the bake age on 2026-10-29; remove this entry then.

Root override pins fast-uri 4.2.3, the first 4.x release that fixes GHSA-w74x-v6f9-j3xg (moderate), GHSA-wjr9-j795-jxcr (moderate), GHSA-xhq7-xmqj-769h (low) and GHSA-333x-w4r6-6crp (low), all published 2026-10-23 and blocking the Dependency Audit gate. 4.2.3 was published 2026-10-19 22:51Z, inside the 7-day bake window; it reaches the bake age on 2026-10-26, so remove this entry on 2026-10-27.
